question.text: In Example 3 (Fund TM), Class B units held from April 1, 2020 to April 15, 2024 are:

answer.text: Long-term (>12 months, classified as equity-oriented Cat III AIF)

explanation.text: The Logic: Holding > 12 months (4+ years) qualifies as long-term for equity-oriented investment fund. The Trap: Short-term would need <=12 months. Cross-Exam Context: Directly from Example 3. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Help clients time unit transfers to qualify for LTCG.
